**International Gaming Alliance Enters Three-Year Master Services Agreement With Lottery.com International**


**LAS VEGAS, Nevada — August 24, 2026 —** Eva Live Inc. (NASDAQ: GOAI) (“Eva Live” or the “Company”), an artificial intelligence and technology company, today announced its expansion into the global online gaming and lottery industry through its 60% majority ownership of International Gaming Alliance (“IGA”). IGA has entered into a three-year Master Services Agreement with Lottery.com International Limited.


The relationship creates an international operating framework across Canada, Central America, South America, Southeast Asia and West Africa, combining Lottery.com International’s gaming technology, digital brands, affiliate and media infrastructure with Eva Live’s artificial intelligence, software development, advertising technology, analytics and customer-acquisition capabilities.


### Key Highlights


- Eva Live owns 60% of International Gaming Alliance and appoints two of IGA’s three managers.
- IGA’s three-year agreement with Lottery.com International covers approved lottery and gaming operations, technology, affiliate marketing, digital media, commercialization and international expansion.
- IGA has access, as necessary for its performance, to Lottery.com International technologies including NEXUS and SPEKTRUM.
- The framework covers approved activities in Canada, Central America, South America, Southeast Asia and West Africa, with additional territories subject to approval.
- IGA may establish affiliate, media, referral and commercial partnerships and may collaborate on approved initiatives involving Sports.com, Concerts.com and TicketStub.com.
- Technology and intellectual property developed by IGA in performing its services remain owned by IGA unless otherwise agreed in writing.


### Eva Live Brings AI and Customer Acquisition to Gaming


Eva Live intends to deploy its existing AI, software, digital advertising, analytics and customer-acquisition infrastructure through IGA to support international gaming operations, customer growth, engagement and commercialization.


### Management Commentary


**David Boulette, CEO of Eva Live, commented:** “This transaction gives Eva Live a majority-owned platform in international gaming with access to established technology, digital brands, affiliate and media capabilities. By combining that infrastructure with Eva Live’s AI, advertising technology and customer-acquisition capabilities, we believe IGA can become a scalable new growth vertical for the Company.”


### Global Market Opportunity


Independent industry research cited by the Company projects the global online gambling market to grow from approximately $97.7 billion in 2026 to more than $200 billion by 2033. Eva Live believes IGA provides a platform to participate in this expanding digital market while leveraging technology and customer-acquisition capabilities already developed by the Company.


### About International Gaming Alliance


International Gaming Alliance is a gaming technology, operations and international commercialization company majority owned by Eva Live Inc. IGA provides operational, development, affiliate, technology and commercialization services across international gaming and digital consumer markets.


### About Eva Live Inc.


Eva Live Inc. (NASDAQ: GOAI) is an artificial intelligence and technology company focused on developing and commercializing AI-powered platforms, advertising technologies and software-driven businesses. Through its majority ownership of International Gaming Alliance, Eva Live has expanded its technology, AI and digital customer-acquisition capabilities into the international gaming and lottery industry.


For more information, visit[www.evaxai.com](http://www.evaxai.com/) .
